title: Component warehouse
subtitle: Manage global version inventory for sandbox components. Missing versions are automatically downloaded during sandbox creation or restoration, or you can manually dispatch preinstall tasks here.
emptyHint: Import a one-click package from GitHub, CNB, or a local upload.
disabled: Component warehouse is disabled because S3 is not configured on CubeOps.
jobsSubtitle: Track one-click package imports and node preinstall progress.
noJobsDesc: There are currently no preinstall tasks running or in history.
noImportJobsDesc: Import progress will appear here after you start an import.
deleteConfirm: Delete {{component}} {{version}} ({{arch}}) from the warehouse? Existing local copies on nodes will not be deleted.
preinstallHint: After dispatching, the target node will download this component version in the background. This action does not create a sandbox.
importSubmitted: Import started. Track progress on the jobs page.
importTimeout: Import timed out. Check the warehouse list later.
noMissing: All known nodes already have this version.
timeoutNote: Sandbox creation/restoration will wait up to 10 minutes for component downloads. If cubeops_addr is unset on the node, missing components will cause an immediate failure.
componentEmpty: This component has no artifacts yet.
componentEmptyHint: You can return to the warehouse overview to import a one-click package.
